    Season 3 of
    Shrinking consists of 11 episodes. The season premiered on Apple TV+ on January 28, 2026, with a special one-hour episode, followed by weekly releases on Wednesdays until the finale on April 8, 2026. It is slightly shorter than Season 2 (12 episodes) but longer than Season 1 (10 episodes).

    • Finale Date:
      April 8, 2026
    • Release Schedule: Weekly on Wednesdays
    • Special Feature: The premiere episode is a full hour.
